note: Fog-noir character cards for investigation, uneasy trust and costly exploration. Preserve approved face identities; do not homogenize the cast into anime or glamorous heroes. Faction, profession and fog-rot stage must agree with the character cards. Edits use the current portrait as the identity reference. See docs/guide/world-art-direction.md and docs/guide/world-art-prompts.json.

style.prefix: Character portrait, dark-fantasy fog-noir illustration, painterly semi-realistic rendering, cold desaturated palette of greys, teal and rust, dense grey-white sea fog with nearby harbor silhouettes fading into it and no distinct sky, low-key cinematic lighting with soft diffuse face separation, weathered gothic harbor atmosphere, half-body bust, three-quarter view,
